basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Mumbai, India. I've recently dived into the world of gaming, particularly Star Citizen, after hearing so much about it from friends. I'm also interested in sustainable living, exploring zero waste options, and occasionally dabble in cryptocurrency discussions. I typically browse Reddit late at night, after work, where I manage a small e-commerce business. Currently single, I'm more focused on building my career and exploring new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming and tech acquired through self-teaching and discussions with friends. My knowledge in sustainable living comes from online resources and participating in community events. My interest in cryptocurrency is relatively new, fueled by market trends and online articles.
